model_reference.proof: Hull convexity bounds radial norm and z; choose nearest nominal ring and angular column. Squared radial distance is convex in rho, so its maximum on [0,rho_max] is an endpoint. Add the measured maximum atom displacement by the triangle inequality. Every hull point is within this bound of an actual selected atomic center.

outward_tails: All centers lie between the two endpoint z planes; distance to every atom increases on the outward axial rays. Segment minima include endpoints.
scope: Checked known ball model, finite-grid passage witness and sufficient hull cover; no physical aperture area, global optimum bottleneck or biological claim
